map.波动率是对称离散度；回撤只衡量下行、且是峰值到谷底的累计跌幅，更贴合\"实际体验: Volatility is a symmetric dispersion; drawdown only measures downside, the cumulative drop from peak to trough, and better fits "the worst loss actually experienced".
map.本页统一以正数表示跌幅（如 30%），\"最大\"指跌幅绝对值最大。若与他处用负: This page always shows a drawdown as a positive decline (e.g. 30%); "maximum" means the largest decline in absolute value. If you mix it with conventions that use a minus sign for losses, convert the sign yourself — the magnitude is the same.
map.最大回撤（本页口径：回撤一律以正数表示跌幅）：MD=(峰值−谷值)÷峰值×100: Maximum drawdown (this page's convention: a drawdown is always shown as a positive decline): MD = (peak − trough) ÷ peak × 100 (%); linked values: drawdown magnitude (absolute) = peak − trough, gain needed to recover = (peak ÷ trough − 1) × 100 (%; when the trough is 0 the price has already been wiped out and no gain can recover it, so it shows "—"). Validation: peak must be > 0, and trough must be ≥ 0 and not above the peak (there is no drawdown when the price never fell); otherwise a message is shown and the calculation stops. Rule: no fixed grading; a deeper drawdown needs a non-linearly larger gain to recover (e.g. a 50% drawdown needs a 100% gain).
